exposure: history or presence of maternal illnesses and surgery
cohort: The study included 377 pregnant women with preterm labor (23-37 weeks) and 423 pregnant women with term delivery referring to Ayatollah Rohani Hospital of Babol city, Iran.
finding: The study found a statistically significant association between employment during pregnancy, history of preterm labor, first-trimester bleeding, fast food consumption, UTI, anemia, hypertension, and smoking habits with premature delivery.
cross-section timing: At the time of labor/delivery or presentation with preterm labor (23-37 weeks)
gest_age: 23-37 weeks for preterm labor group; term delivery for control group
